study type: Systematic review and meta-analysis of birth cohorts
cohort: The study included pooled data from 4463 participants belonging to Maori, Pacific, and European ethnic groups across four birth cohorts (1926-40, 1941-55, 1956-70, and 1971-85) in New Zealand.
finding: Infection rates of H. pylori declined in more recent birth cohorts across all ethnic groups, with Pacific peoples having the highest prevalence, followed by Maori, and then European.
